chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The flu is an army from the armies of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sends it to the illness to eradicate it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic view on the cause and purpose of the flu according to hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (as) conveys that the Prophet (saww) identified nasal congestion (zukaam) as a 'soldier' of Allah, illustrating the Shia concept of 'amrad' (illness) as a purposeful, active agent rather than a passive defect. This view aligns with the theological principle that bodily ailments serve as divine mechanisms to expel internal impurities or diseases, reflecting a holistic understanding of health where suffering has a specific, curative function.

en.hubeali: H 15025 – Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, who has narrated the following: ‘Abu Abdullahasws has said;

‘The Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The flu is an army from the armies of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sends it to the illness, to eradicate it’.
en.sarwar: 579. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhas Bin Al-Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, by his unbroken chain going up to Abu Abdullah (a.s.), the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said: ‘The Rasool Allah (saww) said: ‘There is no one from the children of Adam (as) except that there are two veins within him. A vein in his head which incites the leprosy, and a vein in his body which incites the vitiligo.

So if the vein in the head gets incited, Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic Makes the flu to overcome it until the illness flows out from it. And if the vein which is in the body gets incited, Allah (azwj) Makes it to be overcome by the abscesses until the illness flows out from it. So if one of you sees the flu and abscesses, so he should Praise Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic for the health’. And he (a.s.) said; ‘Flu has origin in the head’.
